next_step_summary: Product-owner validation gate inserted after the code-level geometry freeze and before serverless OCR benchmarking. PR #211 adds only the first Android runtime layer: local file/content URI -> bounded source validation -> EXIF-normalized orientation -> exact grayscale preview with long side <=1800 -> local cache PNG and dimensions. It does not estimate angle, deskew, crop, run OCR, upload data, call a backend, or modify the frozen Python geometry baseline. Next implement android-geometry-angle-estimator-v1 over this bounded preview contract. Then add physical full-frame deskew and a small validation UI before the Samsung A55 manual validation run. serverless-gpu-ocr-viability-benchmark-v1 remains deferred until that device validation sequence is recorded.
